children: Overview
Canada gold miner's Q3 revenue rose 21% yr/yr, driven by higher realized gold prices
Adjusted net EPS for Q3 increased to $0.42 from $0.30 a year earlier
Company repurchased $135 mln in shares during Q3, bringing total buybacks to nearly $600 mln
Outlook
IAMGOLD maintains 2026 gold production guidance at 720,000-820,000 oz
Company expects consolidated 2026 cash costs, excluding royalties, in upper half of $1,100-$1,250/oz range
IAMGOLD anticipates exceeding upper end of 2026 AISC guidance, including royalties, due to higher gold prices
Result Drivers
HIGHER GOLD PRICES - Co said increased realized gold prices supported higher revenue and earnings in Q3
COST REDUCTIONS AT CÔTÉ - Discontinuation of external contractor crushing and lower mill maintenance costs reduced production costs at Côté Gold
HIGHER PRODUCTION AT WESTWOOD AND ESSAKANE - Increased output at Westwood and Essakane contributed to overall mine-site free cash flow
